证据不足时refused且claims为空；工具持续失败时escalated且claims为空。
需要资料时先search；可以用英文技术关键词。最后一次请求只能输出最终动作。

- Multi-round conversation, where the user may chat with the application multiple times in the same chatting session.", "truncated": false, "metadata": {"release": "v0.10.2", "commit": "01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6", "source_type": "documentation"}}, {"id": "E8f67c161db19fd79595d505f", "chunk_id": "1b033b6229bf05e4e1b8f142", "parent_id": "e2f783bc52fc6d11dba52420", "source": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-prefix_caching.md", "sha256": "0a8a9e9095055c4f8e0cdaf078e3194ab06428222d65abb9c827f6879607ce61", "locator": "/Users/jennyma/Projects/InfraAgent/evals/agent-e2e-v1/corpus/vllm-prefix_caching.md#L3-L13", "content": "Since prefix caching is almost a free lunch and won’t change model outputs, it has been widely used by many public endpoints (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, etc) and most open source LLM inference frameworks (e.g., SGLang).

    ref_cnt: int

    prev_free_block: Optional["KVCacheBlock"] = None

observation: {"action":"final","status":"answered","answer":"在 vLLM 引擎中启用 APC（自动前缀缓存）的参数是 `enable_prefix_caching=True`，即在 vLLM engine 中设置该参数即可启用 APC [E01b5eca3bc32482365ead7c6]。该证据来自 vLLM 文档（release v0.10.2，commit 01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6），并给出了示例文件 examples/offline_inference/automatic_prefix_caching.py [E01b5eca3bc32482365ead7c6]。","claims":[{"id":"c1","text":"在 vLLM engine 中设置 enable_prefix_caching=True 即可启用 APC。","evidence_ids":["E01b5eca3bc32482365ead7c6"]},{"id":"c2","text":"该启用说明来自 vLLM 文档 release v0.10.2（commit 01efc7ef781391e744ed08c3292817a773d654e6），并附有示例文件 examples/offline_inference/automatic_prefix_caching.py。","evidence_ids":["E01b5eca3bc32482365ead7c6"]}]}
